```yaml
name: Test flake

on:
  push:
    paths:
      - flake.nix
      - flake.lock
      - .github/workflows/test-flake.yml
      - rust-toolchain.toml
      - '**/Cargo.toml'
      - '**/Cargo.lock'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - flake.nix
      - flake.lock
      - .github/workflows/test-flake.yml
      - rust-toolchain.toml
      - '**/Cargo.toml'
      - '**/Cargo.lock'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  test-flake:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    continue-on-error: true
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Nix
        uses: cachix/install-nix-action@v27
        with:
          install_nix: true
          nix_conf: |
            experimental-features = nix-command flakes

      - name: Nix flake check
        run: nix flake check

      - name: Test dev shell initialization
        run: nix develop .#devShell --command "echo 'dev shell initialized'"
```

name: Test flake

on:
  push:
    paths:
      - flake.nix
      - flake.lock
      - .github/workflows/test-flake.yml
      - rust-toolchain.toml

      - '**/Cargo.lock'

    paths:
      - flake.nix
      - flake.lock
      - .github/workflows/test-flake.yml
      - rust-toolchain.toml
      - '**/Cargo.toml'
      - '**/Cargo.lock'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  test-flake:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    continue-on-error: true
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
